content: Open Tuesday to Sunday, 08:00 to 21:00. Closed every Monday. Last food order at 20:00, last drink order at 20:30.
88 Haizhuan Road, Nanzih District, Kaohsiung (高雄市楠梓區海專路88號), 5 minutes on foot from NKUST Nanzih campus.
07-765-4321. Staff answer the phone Tuesday to Sunday, 09:00 to 20:00.
We take cash, credit cards, LINE Pay and JKOPAY. No cheques.
Free Wi-Fi (network: HarborBean, password on your receipt). Power outlets at the long bar table and the window seats (20 seats with outlets).
On weekdays there is no time limit. On Saturday and Sunday each table may stay 2 hours.
Each guest orders at least one drink or one item of NT$80 or more.
Tables for 1 to 8 people can be booked through this chat or by phone. Groups of more than 8 people please call us. We keep a booked table for 15 minutes.
Bring your own cup and get NT$5 off each drink.
Members get 10% off the whole bill. Joining is free at the counter with a phone number.
Most coffee and milk drinks come in Regular or Large. Large costs NT$15 more. Oat milk instead of cow's milk costs NT$15 more. Hand-drip coffee comes in one size only.
Pets are welcome on the outdoor terrace only. Inside, only service animals are allowed.
No car park. Scooters can park in front of the shop. Cars can use the public car park on Haizhuan Road, about 150 m away (NT$20 per hour).
We do not deliver ourselves. You can order through Uber Eats or foodpanda. Takeaway is available at the counter.
